title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space and defense sectors are buzzing with activity, particularly in national security and satellite production. As competition with China intensifies, companies are scrambling to secure funding and partnerships to bolster their capabilities.

themes.title: National Security Ventures
themes.body: Vast's new division for national security projects highlights the increasing intertwining of commercial space with defense needs. This trend is likely to attract more private investment as government contracts become more lucrative.

themes.title: Satellite Production Expansion
themes.body: Relativity Space's plans to ramp up Terran R production in Florida signal a growing demand for launch capacity amidst a crowded satellite market. This move could position them well as more companies seek to deploy constellations.

themes.title: Funding for Space Resilience
themes.body: The recent $1.4B boost to the FY27 budget for space resilience underscores the U.S. government's commitment to enhancing its capabilities in the face of global threats. Expect more companies to vie for these funds as the landscape evolves.

themes.title: International Collaboration Efforts
themes.body: The conclusion of the Allied space-resilience workshop in The Hague reflects a growing recognition of the need for cooperative strategies in space defense. Such initiatives may pave the way for more coordinated responses to emerging threats.
